g.text: Illustrative first-hit capture: uniform wind, prescribed settling, 100% sticking. No CFD or optical loss model.
Error bars: Monte Carlo SD across 3 seeds, not field uncertainty. Tilted rear is not electrically active. No annual PV loss is inferred.
